describes: packages/plugin/stamp: current canonical asset mutations, resources, queue isolation and rollback.

cases.name: a-raster-asset-is-sniffed-and-previews-itself
cases.covers: Raster dimensions size the flattened page; PNG/JPEG resources become canonical PDF assets with derived previews and metadata.

cases.name: supplied-previews-and-sizes
cases.covers: An explicit raster size controls its page; supplied preview bytes and MIME type survive while rendering is skipped.

cases.name: a-loose-pdf-needs-a-size
cases.covers: Current PDFs take their inserted page size without a size hint; a hint cannot override the PDF geometry. Every library is canonical.

cases.name: asset-sources-that-are-refused
cases.covers: Unknown library, unsupported bytes, malformed source/preview and zero-size raster reject on their exact current channels before opening a document.

cases.name: into-an-existing-loose-library
cases.covers: Current createAsset queues on an existing canonical library; an empty library id rejects rather than creating an obsolete loose library.

cases.name: appends-a-page-to-a-canonical-library
cases.covers: Append writes the named page and PieceInfo, extracts/renders it, saves and closes before publishing its descriptor.

cases.name: a-supplied-preview-skips-the-render
cases.covers: A supplied preview skips the append render and preserves MIME type.

cases.name: appends-that-are-refused
cases.covers: Multi-page insert, missing layout, PieceInfo refusal and unknown handle close without publishing; raster append is tested independently with a real successful flatten.

cases.name: an-unsaved-append-changes-nothing
cases.covers: A failed download closes and rolls back descriptors/resources; recovery reopens the unchanged canonical bytes.

cases.name: a-save-that-answers-nothing
cases.covers: Deliberately malformed missing canonical/extracted bytes are kept separate from valid engine DTOs and cause exact later missing-byte refusals.

cases.name: removes-a-canonical-page-first
cases.covers: Delete rewrites canonical bytes before descriptor/resource removal; unknown asset is a no-op.

cases.name: removing-the-last-page-drops-the-library
cases.covers: Current deletion leaves the canonical library and unregistered seed; removing an imported sole page is refused by a conforming engine, preserving all resources.

cases.name: a-failed-page-delete-keeps-the-asset
cases.covers: Refused delete closes without changing descriptor, source or canonical bytes; retry succeeds.

cases.name: removals-are-serialized-per-library
cases.covers: One library queue waits while another proceeds; queued duplicate removals read current state and do not rewrite twice.

cases.name: remove-library
cases.covers: Deleting canonical libraries clears all descriptors and resources; unknown and repeated deletes emit no facts.

cases.name: an-append-queued-behind-a-removed-library
cases.covers: Delete library waits for the earlier page deletion; the later append sees the removed target and rejects.

cases.name: a-loose-append-queued-behind-a-removed-library
cases.covers: Current raster append uses the canonical queue and rejects after an earlier library deletion; no loose-library replacement exists.

cases.name: a-loose-append-finds-its-library-canonical
cases.covers: A canonical raster append reads the queue state after the first delete, uses its rewritten bytes and adds a new PDF page.

cases.name: a-loose-asset-under-a-canonical-id
cases.covers: Preferred library ids cannot replace live canonical ownership: createLibrary allocates a fresh id when the requested id is already taken.

cases.name: a-queued-mutation-after-destroy
cases.covers: Current queued writes can finish after destruction; instance-closed diagnostics drop state updates while cleanup clears the resource maps.
